# AI Chatbot

A chatbot using **[@robojs/ai](/docs/ai)** and TypeScript for intelligent conversations.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/ai" title="@robojs/ai" description="AI plugin for Robo.js." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/ai-chatbot-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Configure your OpenAI API key in `.env`:

```bash
OPENAI_API_KEY=your-api-key
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Natural language conversations
- Context awareness
- Custom system prompts
- Voice support

## Configuration

<Files>
  <Folder name="src" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="commands" defaultOpen>
      <File name="ping.ts" note="/ping" />
    </Folder>
    <Folder name="events" defaultOpen>
      <File name="messageCreate.ts" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
  <Folder name="config" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="plugins" defaultOpen>
      <Folder name="robojs" defaultOpen>
        <File name="ai.ts" note="AI plugin config" />
      </Folder>
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
  <File name=".env" note="API keys" />
</Files>

Configure the AI in `config/plugins/robojs/ai.mjs`:

```javascript
export default {
  model: 'gpt-4',
  systemMessage: 'You are a helpful assistant.'
}
```

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
